what: The props shadow ledger (tools/props.js, CLAUDE.md "The props model"): the model's mean for every expected player and stat as the page showed it before each puck drop, frozen then, and every DraftKings main line on those players graded after the final against the model's chance and DraftKings' fair chance. The page shows the model as on trial until this bar is passed.

bar.sample: the first 12,000 DraftKings main lines graded over or under (a push on a whole-number line drops out) on calls made with the registered constants, in the order they were graded (then the puck drop, the game id, the line's place in the record); about 170 games at some 70 graded lines a game, three to four weeks of the regular season
pass_if: log loss (chances clipped to 1e-6): the model's minus DraftKings' fair chance's (all of the margin on the Over: 1 - the Under's implied), its paired bootstrap 90% interval (10,000 resamples of the GAMES in the sample, seed 0, 5th to 95th percentile) wholly below 0
Brier score: the same, its interval wholly below 0

flat bets are up: one unit at DraftKings' closing price on the Over wherever the model's chance beats the Over price's implied chance (margin left in) by 5 points or more, else on the Under where its chance beats the Under price's by 5 points; the units on the sample more than 0 (no bets is not up)
bar.otherwise: FAIL: the tracking stops (no new calls; calls already frozen are still graded), and the page never calls the model's chance an edge or "model says"
bar.if_pass: PASS makes it a candidate to be shown as more than on trial, by a change of its own; nothing on the page moves by itself
bar.before: no verdict before 12,000: until then the summary gives the running numbers and how many of the 12,000 are in, never a verdict or a word of passing

model.dist: skaters: negative binomial (mean, r of the stat; r null is Poisson); saves: normal (mean, sd) rounded to whole saves; tools/props.js dist()

summary.standing: 6661 of 12000 graded lines toward the verdict; the bar is judged at 12000, not before
